name: India Motor Parts & Accessories Limited
about: India Motor Parts & Accessories Limited engages in the sale and distribution of automobile spare parts and accessories for the automotive aftermarket in India. The company offers adaptable ford and cooling systems; wheel cylinders, TVS sprinters and girlings, rotors, gear and engine oils, kit lined shoes, clutch boosters, brake pads, and air dryers; rotary pumps and inline filters; struts, shocks, and bush kits; wiper and starter motors, filters, fan motors, and alternators; tank units/fuel level sensors, sensors, and instrument clusters; suspension parts and rack and pinions; brake linings; and air springs. It also provides high tensile fasteners; TR and ball bearings; turbochargers; clutches and horns; wheels; throttle body cleaners, liquid wax, one-step compounds, engine oil flush and additives, diesel tank additives, choke and carb cleaners, and auto accessories tapes; headlights, auto electrical wires, and rear-view mirrors; mineral, synthetic, and stroke motor oils; bimetallic brushes and king pin units; steering pump assemblies; torque rod bushes, suspension bush kits, oil seals, mounting products, load cushions, lift axle bushes, centre joint rubbers, and axle bellows; and oil, fuel, and water pump assembly products. India Motor Parts & Accessories Limited was incorporated in 1954 and is based in Chennai, India.
